description: Register a dagster-pagerduty PagerDutyService for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

api_token_env_var.label: Api Token Env Var
api_token_env_var.description: Env var holding a PagerDuty REST API token.

from_email_env_var.label: From Email Env Var
from_email_env_var.description: Env var holding the email of a valid PagerDuty user (used as `From:` header on writes).

events_routing_key_env_var.label: Events Routing Key Env Var
events_routing_key_env_var.description: Optional env var holding a PagerDuty Events API v2 routing key (integration key). Needed only for `send_alert` / `resolve_alert`.

name: PagerDuty Resource
